## ACCEPT — objectui#8316 / PR objectui#8662, `domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat, 2026-09-08T20:58Z

Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main` at head `e17ff0487`, ⛔ not against the report's narrative.

### ⭐ The measurement the brief demanded first: the pin was LIVE, ⛔ not already broken

| leg | reading |
|:--|:--|
| pristine | 9 passed, exit 0 |
| `as ComponentMeta` re-added | **exit 1** — *expected … not to match `/\bas\s+ComponentMeta\b/`* |
| the angle-bracket spelling re-added | ⭐ **exit 0 — 9 passed. The pin is BLIND to it.** |

⇒ ⭐ **half the card's complaint is now measured rather than asserted**, and triage's `p2` re-grade trigger did **not** fire (⛔ the grade is triage's either way). Every restore proven by blob hash against HEAD, ⛔ never by an exit code.

### ⭐⭐ A correction to triage's routing — measured

Triage wrote that the fix lands in *"`packages/lint` / gate configuration"*. ⛔ **There is no `packages/lint`.** This seat confirms independently: `packages/lint` is absent from `origin/main` (exit 1) while `packages/core` resolves in the same query (exit 0, control). Configuration is one root flat `eslint.config.js`, and **single-file path scoping is already the house style** — `files: ['packages/types/src/objectql.ts']` sits three config objects above the new one.

⇒ the lane was right, the named package was not. ⛔ No `pm:retriage` hung: nothing was blocked by it and the card lands now. Recorded here for triage.

### What this seat re-measured on the PR

| claim | reading | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the rule is **scoped to one file** | `files: ['packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts']` | ✅ |
| ⛔ no repo-wide ban smuggled in | that is the only `consistent-type-assertions` config object; fenced in the config comment, the PR body **and** a test | ✅ |
| the `gen-manifest.ts` sibling is ⛔ not caught | it is in `packages/sdui-parser` — a different package, so the narrowest sound scope does not reach it. ⭐ Pinned with its own control: the sibling text scores **2** at `Registry.ts` (`as unknown as T` is two assertions) and **0** at the sibling, so the 0 is a reading | ✅ |
| scope, overall | 5 files, +202 −10 | ✅ |

### ⭐ Three failure proofs, and the third is the one that shows the rule is not a blunt instrument

`as ComponentMeta` ⇒ **exit 1** at `412:10`. The angle-bracket spelling ⇒ **exit 1**, same rule, same coordinate — ⭐ the hole the old pin was blind to, now closed. And `as const` ⇒ **exit 0**, still permitted. ⇒ the guard discriminates rather than banning everything, each leg with its mutant blob recorded and each restore proven by hash.

⭐ Plus a **guard of the guard**: a 6-test suite driving ESLint's Node API against the real config, itself ablated by repointing the scope at a non-existent file — 4 of 6 red, config restored and proven by hash.

### ⛔ The retirement is real, and proven at the seam

The two `not.toMatch` **absence** assertions are removed; the **positive** half (the local is annotated) stays, because that is a different claim — about text that must be **present**, which ESLint would not notice being deleted. ⭐ Proven at the crossover: with `as ComponentMeta` re-added, the old pin file is **green at 9 passed while eslint is red at the same instant**.

### The flagged deviation — ⭐ accepted, and it was right to flag it

The brief said the cast site is *read, not moved*. The dev touched `Registry.ts` — **comment only**, verified: every added and removed line in that hunk is a comment line. The reason is the card's own subject: one docblock sentence said the types test *"pins the cast's absence"*, and this PR makes that **false**.

⇒ ⭐ shipping a pointer that lies is precisely the rot this card exists to stop. And the edit sits **above** `export function withElementDataSourceInput`, which is where the remaining pin's slice **begins** — ⇒ outside the pinned region, so it cannot make the surviving assertion vacuous. ⛔ No revert asked for.

### ⚠️ A self-inflicted incident the dev reported rather than buried — and it is a new trap for this seat's rule set

An ablation script's `git checkout HEAD -- packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts` restore leg **silently reverted the dev's own uncommitted docblock edit to that same file**. ⭐ It was caught by reading `git status`, ⛔ not the exit code — *"the restore reported success, because it was one."*

⇒ **restore-by-checkout is destructive to uncommitted work on the path it restores**, and its success is not evidence that nothing else was lost. ⚠️ Ablate on a **committed** tree, or the restore eats your own edits and tells you it worked. Added to this seat's standing corrections.

### Next

`ci-wait` on `e17ff0487`, then flip, **post-flip** guard, arm SQUASH, enqueue from the timeline event.

**Landing probe, scoped now:** on a re-fetched `origin/main`, `eslint.config.js` carries exactly **one** `consistent-type-assertions` object scoped to `files: ['packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts']`; the two `not.toMatch` absence assertions are **gone** from the types test while its positive `toContain` **remains** (⭐ firing control — a probe that only checked the removals would pass on a file emptied of both); `scripts/__tests__/registry-assertion-ratchet-8316.test.ts` exists; nonsense control exits 1.

## LANDED — objectui#8316 via PR objectui#8662, merged `f0e72e266`

`merged_at 2026-09-08T21:16:25Z`; `removed_from_merge_queue@21:16:24Z` with `merged: true` ⇒ that removal **is** the merge, ⛔ not a dequeue.

### ⚠️ This seat's probe read a false 2 first — published, ⛔ not quietly re-run

The Armed note's probe wanted **0** remaining `not.toMatch` absence assertions. A whole-file count returned **2**, which reads as *the dev did not remove them*. ⛔ That was **this seat's bad probe**, and the cause is a shape its own errata names verbatim: **a whole-file grep hits the docblock that quotes the removed string.**

The two hits were:

```
:53   * The cast's ABSENCE used to be read here too, as two `not.toMatch` regexes   <- the COMMENT recording the removal
:182  expect(src.slice(parentStart, parentEnd)).not.toMatch(/^\s+binding\??:/m);    <- a DIFFERENT, surviving assertion about `binding`
```

⇒ neither is a cast-absence assertion. ⚠️ **Twice today this seat has hit a trap from its own list on a landing probe** — the wrong-indent anchor on objectui#8630, and this. ⛔ The rule holds: look at the text before reporting a defect.

### Landing probe, re-run correctly and controlled (tip `f0e72e266`)

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `consistent-type-assertions` config objects | **1** — ⛔ no repo-wide ban smuggled in |
| its scope | `files: ['packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts']` — one file |
| `not.toMatch` in **code** (comments excluded) | **1**, the unrelated `binding` assertion |
| ⭐ **cast-absence assertions remaining** | **0** |

| `scripts/__tests__/registry-assertion-ratchet-8316.test.ts` exists | ✅ |
| nonsense control | ✅ exit 1 |

### What is now true that was not

The repo declared this cast retired, and the only thing standing behind that declaration was a **source-text pin** — ⛔ formatting-brittle, ⛔ blind to the angle-bracket spelling, and ⭐ **silent when it drifts**, because it asserts an **absence** and an absent string is also what a broken pattern returns. And `tsc` cannot see the regression at all: re-adding the cast leaves `tsc --noEmit` at exit 0.

⇒ from `f0e72e266` the absence is held by an **AST rule**, scoped to the one file the objectui#6950 ruling is about, **proven to redden for both spellings** and proven to still permit `as const`.

⭐ **The pin was measured LIVE before it was retired** — not broken, but **blind**: re-adding `as ComponentMeta` reddened it, re-adding the angle-bracket form left it green at 9 passed. ⇒ half the card's complaint was measured rather than asserted, and the replacement closes exactly that half.

### Recorded for triage, ⛔ no `pm:retriage` hung

Triage's routing said the fix lands in *"`packages/lint` / gate configuration"*. ⛔ **There is no `packages/lint`** — confirmed independently by this seat (absent from `origin/main` while `packages/core` resolves in the same query). The **lane** was right; the named package was not. Nothing was blocked by it.

### ⛔ Deliberately out of scope, and it stayed out

The `as unknown as RegistryConfigLike[]` sibling in `packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts` is ⛔ **not** caught — a different package, so the narrowest sound scope does not reach it, and ⛔ nothing was contorted in either direction to make that so. ⭐ Pinned with its own control: the sibling text scores **2** at `Registry.ts` (`as unknown as T` is two assertions) and **0** at the sibling — the 2 is what makes the 0 a reading.
